title: Smart List & Export Functionality for Leads
text:
## Smart List & Export Functionality for Leads
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079364

## Overview
Site administrators can export lead data or create Smart Lists based on filtered lead results. These tools make it easy to save targeted lead groups for future use or download lead information for external analysis and reporting.
To access these features:
Navigate to Interactions » Member Leads.
Apply any desired filters to narrow your lead results.
Open the List Actions dropdown menu.
Select the action you would like to perform.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485599/original/6qbrio2Ee_H9ZPY6sEpUgZr1IhvSnUbHrA.png?1687814623 | alt: ]

## Export Lead Results
Select the "Export Current Results" option from the drop-down:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485615/original/gGldtA6ElWUMOdWdG62R-LBgeCzXaacyCw.png?1687814656 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485796/original/rTox4gm8dtdO-j2Ude0uHIvYD8LPcJwY3Q.gif?1687814834 | alt: ]
Once the export is complete, the lead data will be downloaded as a compressed ZIP file containing the exported results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485789/original/Ko2ILQzN4xFOwas-xHxIebUovNU7Ad4vYQ.png?1687814816 | alt: ]
In order to export leads, the Export Member Data add-on is required :
» Export Member Data Add-On

## Create a Smart List from Lead Results
Select the "Create Smart List from Results" option from the drop-down:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485826/original/u6EkjZMyIpTOeBipIXQ48id-DkMTguVTmA.png?1687814893 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485860/original/3kIY8_LAPIOsM4is8pyvigLpU3dAKoFzTg.gif?1687814953 | alt: ]
After the Smart List has been created, select Go To Leads Smart List to view and manage the newly generated list.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12127485918/original/E4LmkJb3c8dcQk5VnXdKVYfRY6ELX5DOSg.png?1687815023 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12169869641/original/gHvPx70wmI-0ZNF_1EeQT0xHinPAw_Hzfg.png?1761943368 | alt: ]
